articles.title: America's sppokiest haunted hospital
articles.summary: The Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum in West Virginia looks like the asylum of nightmares and for many, it was. But it started out as a place of compassion whose massive overcrowding lead to desperate measures by doctors and staff. Daily and nightly tours now offer visitors its complex history, along with an occasional paranormal scare.

articles.readingText:
The Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum in West Virginia looks like the asylum of nightmares and for many, it was.

But it started out as a place of compassion whose massive overcrowding lead to desperate measures by doctors and staff.

Daily and nightly tours now offer visitors its complex history, along with an occasional paranormal scare.
articles.readingTextZh:
西弗吉尼亚州的跨阿勒格尼精神病院（ Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum ）看起来像是噩梦的庇护所，对许多人来说确实如此。

但它最初是一个富有同情心的地方，其巨大的拥挤导致医生和工作人员采取绝望的措施。

每日和每晚的游览现在为游客提供了复杂的历史，以及偶尔的超自然恐慌。

The Justice Department is sending more than 1,000 election monitors to polling places in all 50 states, and the Republican National Committee, Democrats and outside groups are deploying observers too.

What they document could shape challenges after the polls close, Gabe Cohen reports.
